summary: Read-only design of #27 Level-2 C0: restore the codegen emitter as a DEVICE-FRAGMENT emitter (not __global__) + fusion-synthesis on the real elementwise/reduce lowerers, fp64-gated; produce a concrete MVP build spec

spec.mvp: THE SMALLEST fp64-GATED FUSION WIN: fold the r1 residual+bias add (sc.work[r,j] += Xin[r,j] + out_b[j], model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1554-1557) INTO the out() epilogue accessor of the out_proj fwd GEMM (dectc_gemm_fwd_f32, :1196 — the fp32-output wrapper). Emit a __device__ __forceinline__ Out-shaped functor SynthEpiR1 whose operator()(int m,int n,float v) computes sc.work[m*d+n] = v + __bfloat162float(Xin[m*d+n]) + L.out_b[n], dropped in as the Out template-param of tc_gemm_block_unpipelined (:687) at the out_proj call site, behind a #ifndef SG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_R1 guard whose default (off) path is the byte-identical existing lambda+separate pass. This eliminates one full nrows*d smem write+read pass AND one __syncthreads per layer — pure transport, fewer barriers.\n\nWHY IT IS THE RIGHT (and only viable) FIRST TARGET, evidence-backed: (1) It is the ONE fusion provably bit-identical (C1-clean by construction). out_proj uses dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 which stores RAW fp32 via out(m,n,v){Yf32[m*Nout+n]=v} (:1196 — NO bf16 round). The r1 fold is pure POINTWISE over the SAME (row,col) index space: v + Xin[m,n] + out_b[n] — no reduction, no cross-element dependency, no reassociation. Folding into out() writes the byte-identical fp32 value to the same address. Verified :1549-1557. (2) It WINS perf where qkv does NOT: it removes a barrier+pass (the :1554-1557 pass becomes a register fold in the GEMM epilogue), whereas the qkv bias pass (:1534-1538) is standalone between a GEMM and attention with no adjacent pass to fuse — saves zero barriers. (3) It does NOT touch the LN reduce: sc.work is still materialized to smem identically, and dectc_ln_fwd_tile (:1374) re-reads it with its UNCHANGED per-row j=threadIdx.x mapping → dec_block_sum tree input order preserved → no fp32 drift. (4) It demonstrates C0's ACTUAL deliverable — the generative path emitting a device-inlinable fragment that reaches the production build and passes the fp64+A/A/A gate — on the cleanest legal lever, so even a REVERT verdict proves the path end-to-end.

phases.name: Phase C0.0 — RE-BASELINE the blocker (the designs name the wrong one; do this FIRST)
steps: VERIFIED: from grokking_optimizers.codegen import emit_variant_source, CodegenError SUCCEEDS on the real path. compile.py:32879 _register_consolidated_module_aliases() registers sys.modules['grokking_optimizers.codegen']=compile.py at import time (:32894). All four designs' premise 'codegen DOESN'T EXIST / ghost import fails-open to macros-only' is FALSE once compile.py is imported (which the autotune path always does). The MED.6 warn-once at :14650 does NOT fire for a missing-module reason.

VERIFIED the REAL blocker is artifact SHAPE: the aliased emit_variant_source (:27840+) renders Jinja _BUNDLED_TEMPLATES whose body is __global__ __launch_bounds__ + extern C void launch_<name>_step(...) <<<...>>> (:27009/:27025) — a host-launched standalone kernel = the exact C2 violation. _variant_macros does NOT fail open; it succeeds emitting the WRONG KIND of artifact.

VERIFIED a SECOND hard blocker the designs mis-state as 'works UNCHANGED': the _emitted_sources KEY MISMATCH. _variant_macros stashes on spec._emitted_sources[config_key(config)] (:14643) but build_jit reads spec._emitted_sources[f'{won_ckey}:{won_origin}'] (:17852). Keys differ — the swap can NEVER fire as-is. Must be fixed in C0 or the pipeline is green-but-fake (ships a template build under a generated winner's timing — the exact #16/P0-3 false-green these gates exist to stop).
phases.deliverable: A corrected C0 problem statement: the work is (a) add a NEW fragment-emitting entry point emitting a __device__ functor header NOT a __global__, (b) fix the _emitted_sources keying so the swap can fire, (c) re-architect the A2 per-candidate gate (decoupled, not wired) — NOT 'restore a missing module'. Record in the ledger before any code is scoped.
phases.risk: If skipped, the team spends effort 'restoring codegen.py' (a no-op — the alias already resolves) and ships a fake-green pipeline (keying bug). CPU-only / read-only; must gate all later phases.

phases.name: Phase C0.1 — the device-fragment emitter (new entry point, not a restore)
steps: Add emit_fragment_source(opgraph, arch, dtype, splice_name) -> (Path('.cuh'), residual_macros) as a NEW function (alias-reachable via grokking_optimizers.codegen). Re-point _variant_macros (:14631) at it behind a new spec.fragment_emitter flag for the FUSION origin, leaving the legacy whole-TU emit_variant_source intact for host-launchable OPTIMIZER-STEP cells (no regression).

Emit struct SynthEpiR1_<ckey> { __device__ __forceinline__ void operator()(int m,int n,float v) const {...} } matching the engine's typename Out shape (:687). REUSE the affine-expression body from _emit_elementwise_cuda (:30019-30046) but SUPPRESS the __global__ wrapper (:30038), grid-stride blockIdx loop (:30042-30048), and extern C launch_ host launcher (:30798). Output a .cuh, never a .cu.

Restrict the legal emit class to fold-order-preserving POINTWISE epilogue ops over the post-wgmma-drain fp32 accumulator: bias-add out_b[n], residual-add Xin[m,n]. Static-assert no reduce node and no k-loop touch — so C1 ascending-k bit-determinism holds by construction. NO bf16-intermediate-round folds.

FIX THE KEYING BUG: make _variant_macros stash on spec._emitted_sources[f'{config_key(config)}:{origin}'] (or make build_jit:17852 read config_key) so the winner-swap and fallback-to-template-with-warning (:17860) engage. Self-test asserting stash key == swap-read key.
Stamp ORIGIN_SYNTH at the variant point (mirror :15822) and set _LAST_VARIANT_ORIGIN[ckey] so pick_winner's #16 gate (:6886, fail-closed) and the fp64 hook (:6938) certify it.
phases.deliverable: grokking_optimizers.codegen.emit_fragment_source emitting a .cuh __device__ functor; a render-and-nvcc-dryrun (validate_with_nvcc_dryrun :28117) proving the functor compiles AND the lowerer reaches the broadcast-bias out_b[n] + per-element Xin[m,n] pattern (retire the C4 lever-existence risk). Keying-bug self-test green.
phases.risk: MED. The OpGraph input model (bare names, :30024-30035) may not cleanly express broadcast-bias out_b[n] vs per-element Xin[m,n] — likely a small lowerer extension. MUST be validated by nvcc-dryrun before claiming device-fusability. If the lowerer can't reach it, hand-author the fragment for C0 and defer OpGraph generality.

phases.name: Phase C0.2 — the megakernel splice seam (byte-identical default, hand-edit the REAL TU)
steps: Add #ifndef SG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_R1 / <hand lambda + separate :1554-1557 pass> #else <SynthEpiR1 as Out, no separate pass> #endif at the out_proj fwd_f32 call site in dectc_forward_tile (:1549-1557). Default (off) emits byte-identical PTX → the 33/33 production gate stays green. Makes the lever a discoverable knob (_discover_kernel_knobs scans #ifndef SG_TUNED_* guards).

Add #ifdef SG_TUNED_EPI_FRAGMENT / #include <epi_<ckey>.cuh> / #endif to the stage header so the fragment is pulled into the transitive #include closure. VERIFIED _walk_includes_one + _hash_sources (:2847/2886/2963) BFS the .cuh closure, so the fragment rides into the source hash + cache key automatically — NO _resolve_sources edit needed (it globs only .cu/.cpp per _AUTO_DISCOVER_EXTS:10361; the .cuh rides in as an include).

DO NOT touch megakernel_codegen.py::_emit_cuda (:165). VERIFIED that emitter produces the GENERIC mega_<model>_<opt>.cu surrogate cell (launch_fused_megakernel; loss != eager per its own comment :216-218) which is NOT the production TC path. The production kernel is the HAND-WRITTEN mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu (launch_fused_decoder_megakernel_tc, wired into _ops); _resolve_sources EXCLUDES mega_decoder_real_adamw_tc.cu via _owns_extension_module_tu (PYBIND11 owner, :10559). The seam MUST be hand-added to model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh (which BOTH the timer TU and the production launcher #include).
phases.deliverable: A guarded seam in model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh whose OFF path is PTX-byte-identical (verify against baseline) and whose ON path consumes the emitted fragment via #include, reaching BOTH the timer TU and the production launcher. 33/33 baseline gate re-confirmed green with the seam present, default off.
phases.risk: LOW-MED. The seam is a hand-edit to a shared header (correct surface, but not codegen-driven — inherent to the production TC path being hand-maintained). Risk is a non-byte-identical OFF path; mitigate with a PTX diff against the pre-seam baseline before proceeding.

phases.name: Phase C0.3 — the A2 per-candidate gate (re-architect; it is DECOUPLED, not a wire-up)
steps: VERIFIED the gate is decoupled: _default_correctness_hook._hook (:7268-7276) IGNORES its candidate arg and calls run_cell_gate(cell_key), which (test_l3tc_tail_gate.py:844) → fused_train_step → dispatch.get_ops() → _cached_ops._resolve() → importlib.import_module('grokking_optimizers._ops') (dispatch.py:485), memoized in _real with NO reset hook (:478-486). The variant build uses a throwaway module suffix for TIMING; only the winner is published as _tuned+_publish_aot_artifact AFTER pick_winner returns (:17873). So today EVERY candidate is gated against the SAME stale loaded _ops — the negative self-test CANNOT be caught in-loop. This is the real A2 gap, NOT 'automatic for a macro-guarded fragment'.

Re-architect the hook so for origin in _SOURCE_GENERATING_ORIGINS it (a) resolves the candidate's fragment from the FIXED _emitted_sources key, (b) rebuilds the GATED production _ops with -DSG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_R1=1 -DSG_TUNED_EPI_FRAGMENT + the fragment path into a coexisting private module/build-dir, and (c) runs run_cell_gate against THAT artifact in a FRESH SUBPROCESS that seeds sys.modules['grokking_optimizers._ops'] from the candidate .so. The subprocess is MANDATORY: _cached_ops is a memoized singleton with no reset hook and optimizers bind() kernel fns, so in-process re-seeding gates the stale first binary.

Keep the flag-only origin path (origin NOT in _SOURCE_GENERATING_ORIGINS) on today's cheap in-process gate — those can't change semantics, so A2 is already correct there. pick_winner stays structurally unchanged (:6938 loop); the per-candidate rebuild lives inside the hook, bounded by correctness_top_k (default 3).

Add an occupancy/regcount PRE-GATE before the expensive subprocess: VERIFIED the launcher REFUSES to launch below 1 CTA/SM (if (occ<1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources, fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:321/:1539) and the fp32-read fwd/dX epilogue ALREADY spills ~2.2 KB when isolated (:446-447, 'the documented blocker'); kIL is capped at 2 to bound accumulator regs (:718/726). A fragment adding register/smem pressure can make the candidate NON-LAUNCHABLE (not slow). Cheaply screen ptxas regcount/spill (the existing spill_stores_norm feature, compile.py:5284) before paying ~125s rebuild + ~60s subprocess.
phases.deliverable: A per-candidate fp64+A/A/A gate that validates the candidate's OWN rebuilt _ops in a subprocess. Negative self-test (plan A2 exit): a deliberately mis-folded fragment (residual added AFTER a bf16 round) is DEMOTED by the fp64 hook; a correct r1 fold passes. build_jit final rebuild (:17847) becomes a re-affirmation shipping the SAME splice the gate validated; keep the template-fallback-with-warning.
phases.risk: HIGH — the largest and least-wired piece. The subprocess gate is net-new mechanism (the designs call it a wire-up; it is not). Cost ~3*(125s+60s) per sweep; mitigate with incremental relink (recompile only the decoder launcher TU, relink prebuilt AOT objects for the other 32 cells — verify the splice macro is confined to model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh's include closure) and the occupancy pre-gate. If incremental relink is infeasible, this phase dominates the schedule.

phases.name: Phase C0.4 — the ONE win on the ratchet (GPU, gated on the maxed primitive)
steps: Precondition: A1 (the maxed decoder primitive) verdict is BAKED — per the campaign state the PIPE tournament resolved (PIPE=2 LOST 857 vs 618ms), so the r1 fuse is measured against the maximal base, not sub-maximal. No A1 wait remains.

Sweep {SG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_R1 in 0,1} under the existing autotuner with the fragment emitter on. Gate: fp64 parity (rel-tol 1e-4) + A/A/A torch.equal (3 seeds) at production scale d=2048, via the new subprocess per-candidate gate.

KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean; else REVERT with a ledger root-cause. Either verdict is a successful C0: the deliverable is the GENERATIVE PATH proven end-to-end (emit fragment -> include -> rebuild gated _ops -> fp64-gate -> ship-the-validated-splice), with the r1 win as the demonstration vehicle. A REVERT (saved barrier off the critical path, or the fragment spills) is an honest recorded dry-well, not a failure of C0.
phases.deliverable: One ledger entry: SG_TUNED_DEC_EPI_R1 KEEP-or-REVERT with 3-seed timing + fp64 verdict, proving the C0 generative path is real and fp64-gated on the production decoder megakernel.
phases.risk: MED. Perf sign uncertain: the r1 fold removes a barrier+pass but the decoder fp32 epilogue may not be on the critical path at d=2048 (scoping says dW staging + non-GEMM fp32 dominate but doesn't isolate the per-pass __syncthreads cost), AND keeping the residual+bias operands live to the GEMM epilogue may cost registers in the zero-margin 1-CTA/SM kernel → spill demotion or non-launch. The occupancy pre-gate (C0.3) catches non-launch; the ratchet catches neutral/negative perf honestly.

dead_ends: DO NOT 'restore the missing grokking_optimizers.codegen module' — it is NOT missing. compile.py:32879 _register_consolidated_module_aliases() aliases sys.modules['grokking_optimizers.codegen'] -> compile.py at import time. The ghost-import 'KILLER' that ALL FOUR designs build on is a non-fact on the real path (the import succeeds; verified by execution after importing compile.py). The real blocker is artifact SHAPE + the _emitted_sources keying bug, not a missing module. Re-baseline before any work (Phase C0.0).

DO NOT fuse the qkv bias-add (model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1534-1538) — it is NOT transport-only. The qkv GEMM (dectc_gemm_fwd) stores __float2bfloat16(v) (:1175), then the pass re-reads bf16->fp32 and adds bias and re-rounds. The in-tree comment (:1532-1533) says the split is INTENTIONAL to match the bf16-faithful oracle qkv=bf(x@bf(in_w)^T+in_b). Folding bias into the epilogue drops the intermediate bf16 round -> different bf16 result -> FAILS the fp64/A-A-A gate by construction. The designs name qkv as the 'marquee'/'cleanest first' target; it is the one fuse that is both bit-illegal AND perf-neutral (standalone pass, no adjacent pass, saves zero barriers).

DO NOT do the r1->LN 'keep-residual-resident, feed LN directly' fold (the headline C-fusion-1 deliverable in designs #1 and #2). It changes thread->element ownership: the r1 residual fold iterates FLAT (idx/d, idx%d, :1554) but dectc_ln_fwd_tile iterates PER-ROW (for s in nrows, inner j=threadIdx.x over d, :1379-1393) using dec_block_sum. Keeping the residual in-register and feeding the LN reduce directly changes which j-values land in each thread's pre-shuffle partial -> different dec_block_sum tree input order -> fp32 bit drift -> C1/A-A-A FAIL. Recoverable only by forcing the fold to copy the LN iteration order, which makes the 'synthesis' a transcription of the hand pass (zero value). Keep sc.work MATERIALIZED; only fold the per-element bias+residual into out() (the MVP), leaving LN's read mapping untouched.

DO NOT lower any reduce node via the stock _emit_reduce_cuda (compile.py:30052) for any LN mean/var. It reassociates the sum via __shfl_down_sync warp-tree + atomicAdd (:30117-30150) -> REORDERS the fp32 reduction -> C1 violation. The only legal reduce is calling the existing dec_block_sum primitive (preserves ascending order), but that needs a float* red smem-scratch arg the OpNode/OpGraph model (:29519-29550) has no representation for. The reduce-crossing fusion is OUT of C0; keep the emit class to pure POINTWISE folds (no reduce node).

DO NOT synthesize the GEMM. Leave _MMA_NATIVE_LOADS_WIRED=False (compile.py:30178) — the native wgmma bodies are a stub (cp.async dest operand is literal 0, :30248) and the owner re-spec is explicit: the hand engine is maxed, synthesize the FUSION not the GEMM.

DO NOT route CUTLASS or CK through this path — they are host-launch-only collectives; the persistent 1-CTA/SM megakernel cannot invoke a host-launched __global__ device-side inside the GridBarrier-coordinated grid (megakernel_common.cuh, no cooperative launch). C2 forbids it. Scoping no-go confirmed.

DO NOT pursue the polyhedral Phase-D path in C0. It is a toy; defer until a hand-OpGraph fusion win exists to compound. Installing islpy/libclang is a Phase-D precondition, NOT a C0 step — and only after the fragment-include path is green.

DO NOT modify megakernel_codegen.py::_emit_cuda (:165) to add the splice seam (design #1 step 4 targets it). VERIFIED that emitter generates the GENERIC surrogate cell (launch_fused_megakernel; loss != eager per its own comment :216-218), which is NOT the production TC path and is excluded by _resolve_sources via _owns_extension_module_tu. The seam belongs in the hand-written model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh, which both the timer TU and the real launcher #include.

DO NOT trust the in-loop fp64 negative self-test to work without re-architecting the hook (design #4 STEP 0 claims it is 'automatic for a macro-guarded fragment'). The hook gates the stale loaded _ops singleton (dispatch.py:531, no reset hook), not the candidate's source; closing this requires a fresh-subprocess gate against a per-candidate rebuilt _ops (Phase C0.3), which is real new machinery.

DO NOT use pattern_bilevel_fusion (compile.py:29960) as the fusion primitive — it emits a single __global__ (:29966). It is reusable ONLY as a node-list concatenator; its outer __global__ wrap must be discarded and replaced by the device-fragment wrapper.
decision_points: AFTER Phase C0.0 (re-baseline): confirm with the owner that C0's scope is 'new fragment emitter + keying fix + subprocess A2 gate', NOT 'restore codegen.py'. If the owner still believes the module is missing, surface the alias-shim evidence (compile.py:32879, import-succeeds proof) before any code is written — the entire design corpus is built on the wrong blocker.

AFTER Phase C0.1 nvcc-dryrun: if the OpGraph lowerer CANNOT reach the broadcast-bias out_b[n] + per-element Xin[m,n] access pattern (the C4 lever-existence risk), DECIDE: hand-author the SynthEpiR1 fragment for C0 (proves the path) and defer OpGraph generality, vs extend the lowerer's input model first. Default: hand-author for C0, extend later — do not block the path on lowerer generality.

AFTER Phase C0.2 PTX diff: if the OFF-path PTX is NOT byte-identical to the pre-seam baseline, STOP and fix the seam before any GPU work — a non-identical default breaks the 33/33 production gate and invalidates every downstream measurement.

AFTER Phase C0.3 cost measurement: if the full gated-_ops rebuild per candidate (~125s) cannot be reduced to an incremental decoder-launcher-TU relink, RE-EVALUATE whether to gate fewer candidates (drop correctness_top_k to 1 for synth origins) or accept the cost. The subprocess gate is correctness-critical and must NOT be dropped; only its breadth/incrementality is negotiable.

AT the occupancy pre-gate (Phase C0.3): if the SynthEpiR1 fragment's ptxas regcount/spill pushes the kernel below 1 CTA/SM (non-launchable), the fuse is DEAD for the register-resident form — DECIDE whether a smem-staged variant (keep the __syncthreads, fuse only the pointwise fold without holding extra operands live) is worth it. Note: that variant likely removes the perf thesis (it keeps the barrier), so a non-launch result here may mean REVERT, not redesign.

AFTER Phase C0.4 verdict (the ratchet gate): if r1 KEEPS (faster on 3+ seeds, parity-clean) -> widen to the r2 residual+bias fold (:1585-1588, same fp32-output class, same machinery) as C-fusion-1 proper, ONE site at a time. If r1 REVERTS on perf (off critical path / spill) -> record the dry-well; the generative path is still proven; do NOT chase more epilogue fuses without first profiling whether the fp32 epilogue is on the d=2048 critical path (scoping suggests dW staging dominates — a DIFFERENT lever class, C-transport-1, not epilogue fusion). Re-evaluate target selection against the profile before spending more C-fusion effort.

BEFORE extending to ViT/Mamba twins: only after the decoder coupling is validated end-to-end on one model. Each model needs its own SG_TUNED_*_EPI seam + per-site operand descriptor; Mamba is smem-bound at d=2048 (scoping) and may not benefit at all — gate the ViT/Mamba expansion on the decoder verdict, do not author all three seams speculatively.
spec.notes:
VERIFICATION SUMMARY (I read the tree, did not trust the design prose). The four designs share a FALSE foundational premise and the feasibility checks correctly flag it: the 'grokking_optimizers.codegen ghost import' is NOT a missing module — compile.py:32879 aliases it to itself at import time; the import SUCCEEDS (proven by execution). The real C0 blockers are three, all confirmed in source: (1) the aliased emit_variant_source emits a host __global__+extern C launch_ (compile.py:27009/27025) = C2-illegal SHAPE, not a fail-open to macros; (2) the _emitted_sources KEY MISMATCH (stash on config_key :14643, read on f'{ckey}:{origin}' :17852) means the winner-swap can never fire — a fake-green hazard ALL designs mis-state as 'works UNCHANGED'; (3) the A2 fp64 gate is DECOUPLED from the candidate artifact (run_cell_gate -> get_ops() -> memoized _cached_ops singleton with no reset hook, dispatch.py:485/531), so per-candidate validation needs a fresh-subprocess rebuilt-_ops gate — real new machinery, not a wire-up.

WHAT IS GENUINELY FEASIBLE (and is the MVP): the out() accessor (model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:687/:1100) is per-element and takes a typename Out functor, so a __device__ __forceinline__ epilogue functor IS device-inlinable (C2 satisfiable). The ONE bit-safe, perf-positive fuse is folding the r1 residual+bias (:1554-1557) into the out_proj fwd_f32 GEMM epilogue: the GEMM stores RAW fp32 (dectc_gemm_fwd_f32 :1196, no bf16 round), the fold is pure pointwise over the same (row,col) space (no reduction, no reassociation), and it removes a barrier+pass while leaving LN's per-row read mapping untouched.

WHAT IS NOT FEASIBLE and must be routed around (feasibility checks correct): the qkv fuse (bf16-intermediate-round, C1 violation + perf-neutral), the r1->LN 'residual-resident' fold (LN iteration-order drift -> bit drift), any reduce-crossing fusion (dec_block_sum scratch-arg not in the OpGraph model + warp-shuffle reassociation), and GEMM synthesis (stub + owner re-spec). The zero-margin 1-CTA/SM occupancy (launcher REFUSES <1 CTA/SM, fused_decoder_megakernel.cuh:321/1539; fp32 epilogue already spills ~2.2KB :446) means an occupancy/regcount pre-gate is mandatory — a fragment can be NON-LAUNCHABLE, not just slow.

HONEST framing: C0's deliverable is the GENERATIVE PATH proven end-to-end (emit fragment -> #include -> rebuild gated _ops -> subprocess fp64-gate -> ship-validated-splice). The r1 perf win is the demonstration vehicle; a REVERT verdict (barrier off critical path, or spill) is a successful C0 with an honest dry-well, NOT a failure. The single highest-leverage corrective vs the designs: STOP leading with qkv (bit-illegal + neutral) and target r1-fp32-epilogue, and build the subprocess A2 gate as its own correctness deliverable rather than assuming it is automatic.
